purpose: Turn the R1 prism-layer-and-evidence blocker into an auditable evidence-retention split preflight before any physical move, evidence deletion, public release claim, or release-switch change.

claim_boundary.allowed_user_claim: The prism-layer-and-evidence blocker now has a machine-checkable evidence-retention split preflight, package-boundary snapshot, consumer matrix, and future split gate.
forbidden_claims: The Prism layer has been physically moved.
Prism evidence has been physically cleaned.
R1 historical asset cleanup is complete.
The registry release action may proceed.

evidence_lifecycle_snapshot.dynamic_check_rule: Current runs lifecycle must remain internally valid; formal run counts may increase as new Prism reviews are added, but package candidates must keep prism/runs absent and any physical cleanup requires explicit future approval.

roots.current_contract: Packaged for alpha readiness because availability, coordination, evidence, archive and runs lifecycle support are used by release readiness and closeout acceptance.
roots.future_target: runtime/prism-tools or internal/prism-tools with stable facades and compatibility aliases

roots.current_contract: Packaged as the human-readable Prism overview for maintainers and advanced users.
roots.future_target: public docs or maintainer docs depending on release profile

roots.current_contract: Tracked formal reports and index stay in source for archaeology and acceptance binding, but they are not part of the current npm package candidate surface.
roots.future_target: private/source archive or documented report archive with explicit public/private policy

roots.current_contract: Run-scoped raw evidence is gitignored/local evidence. It is not a package candidate, must not be bulk-read by default, and must not be physically cleaned without an explicit future approval and lifecycle proof.
roots.future_target: local runtime evidence store or private archive with alias/receipt preservation

candidate_categories.meaning: Prism shell/python tools needed by release readiness, acceptance and evidence checks.
candidate_categories.release_posture: may remain package-visible only if labelled as maintainer/readiness support rather than ordinary end-user workflow

candidate_categories.meaning: Formal Prism reports and index used as durable audit summaries.
candidate_categories.future_target: source archive or public/private documentation split
candidate_categories.release_posture: must stay out of npm package candidates unless a future public report policy explicitly allows it

candidate_categories.meaning: Raw Prism run directories and intermediate evidence.
candidate_categories.future_target: local runtime evidence or private archive
candidate_categories.release_posture: must remain excluded from package candidates and default context loading

candidate_categories.meaning: Provider priority, protected fallback and last-resort rules consumed by Prism selection.
candidate_categories.release_posture: must not be changed without Prism review because it affects reviewer independence and user quota protection

consumer_matrix.split_risk: making npm package candidates inconsistent with the package whitelist or accidentally including raw evidence
making closeout unable to bind independent review evidence to the current task
breaking replay-auditable report archive links or confusing report index counts with current-task quorum
weakening Claude/Kimi priority, Copilot protected fallback, or Codex last-resort boundaries
turning local evidence cleanup into an unsafe default action or losing human-visible evidence retention boundaries

required_before_evidence_cleanup: proof that targets are inactive and unreferenced
explicit Norven approval for any --apply cleanup
required_before_release_ready_claim: prism-layer-and-evidence no longer marked release-blocker-until-resolved, or formal release stays blocked
package-visible Prism files are limited to approved tools/docs
prism/reports and prism/runs remain absent from package candidates unless a future public evidence policy explicitly changes this
raw evidence, local run state and provider secrets are absent from package candidates
future_split_gate.alias_strategy: Future physical moves must keep existing prism/tools, prism/reports and prism/runs references resolvable through wrappers, index migration, import maps or explicit alias resolver entries before path changes.
future_split_gate.rollback_strategy: Each future Prism move tranche must be copy-first, verify, then delete-last; rollback must restore old anchors, report index bindings, package policy counts and Prism acceptance evidence.

result.next_recommended_tranche: Either a future Prism evidence retention physical split with explicit no-delete guarantees, or internal-control-plane file-level physical split dry-run after the Prism evidence boundary is stable.
